neutral_title: SEBI consultation: investor consent and conflicted-transaction thresholds for Alternative Investment Funds
issue_summary_neutral: SEBI issued a consultation paper proposing to standardize how Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) obtain investor consent under AIF Regulations, 2012, including for conflicted transactions. Proposals include standardizing the process/methodology for obtaining investor consent, bringing consistency to the unitholder-approval threshold used across different AIF Regulation provisions and circulars, and rationalizing which transactions fall within the definition of 'conflicted transactions' requiring investor consent, including revisiting the scope of the term 'associate'.
